The spin. The wickets. The magic of Rashid Khan!
Relive some of Rashid Khan's most incredible wicket-taking moments across three seasons representing and captaining MI Cape Town in Betway SA20!
From deceptive spin variations and spectacular dismissals to trademark wicket celebrations, the Afghan superstar has produced some unforgettable moments with the ball in hand!
Watch the Spin Wizard in action as we celebrate his bowling brilliance, match-changing deliveries and incredible skill throughout his Betway SA20 journey.
